clue.text: Is in toilet dealing with son in a state

indicators.note: the first in says the word Is is placed inside the letters for toilet

parts.note: WC, water closet, is a toilet
taken as written
on means about or dealing with
S is the genealogical abbreviation for son
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone in the bathroom is busy with their son somewhere in a US state.
explanation.definitionFit: Wisconsin is one of the fifty United States, in the Midwest.

clue.text: See 6
Or as seagulls fly for food?

indicators.note: the way the gulls fly suggests the letters scattering into a new order

explanation.surface: A whimsical question: is this how gulls fly, swooping for something to eat?
explanation.walkthrough: 'fly' looks like the birds' action but signals the anagram of OR AS SEAGULLS.
explanation.definitionFit: Sausage rolls are a British pastry snack, sausage meat wrapped in puff pastry, a common food.

clue.text: See 14
Easy shots of models

definitions.meaning: in sport, a sitter is a chance so easy it should never be missed
people who sit for a painter or photographer

explanation.surface: A photographer's portfolio of simple pictures of models.
explanation.definitionFit: Sitters are both gift-wrapped scoring chances in football and people posing for portraits.

clue.text: Figurative French article written up — they dig Cantona up top

indicators.note: in this down clue Eric sits above the following piece in the column

parts.note: the NUM, National Union of Mineworkers, represents people who dig coal
Eric Cantona, the Manchester United footballer

indicators.note: in a down clue, written up means the article is read from bottom to top

parts.note: la is the French feminine definite article

explanation.surface: A tangled tribute: the French press writes up how fans adore Cantona playing at the front.
explanation.walkthrough: The NUM is the British coal miners' union. 'written up' turns LA into AL, and 'up top' puts ERIC above it.
explanation.definitionFit: Figurative can mean relating to figures or numbers, so it is a synonym of numerical.

clue.text: Jumps on fools

definitions.meaning: to attack and rob someone in the street

explanation.surface: Someone leaps on idiots, a playground scene.
explanation.definitionFit: To mug is to assault and rob, and mugs are people easily taken in.

clue.text: ie trawlerman's fishy spring produce?

indicators.note: something fishy is suspect or not straight, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the letters of ie trawlerman, the possessive ending being a link

explanation.surface: A fisherman's catch from a spring, a strange product indeed.
explanation.definitionFit: Bottled water drawn from a natural spring is literally what a spring yields, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Turning page, spread goes through sea creatures

indicators.note: turning says the two following pieces are read backwards together

parts.note: marg is short for margarine, a bread spread
to go through something is to use it up

explanation.surface: Flipping a page, a picture spread runs through the marine animals.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turning' reverses P plus MARG to give GRAMP.
explanation.definitionFit: Grampuses are dolphin-like cetaceans, such as Risso's dolphin or the killer whale.

clue.text: Most strong tackles ultimately at United match

indicators.note: ultimately picks the final letter of tackles

parts.note: to can stand for at, as in being to or at home
U is the usual abbreviation for United in team names
a test is an international match in cricket or rugby

explanation.surface: A report on a tough football match where the hardest tackles came at United.
explanation.definitionFit: Stout means sturdy or strong, so the superlative is the strongest.

clue.text: Intellectual pieces detailed story

parts.note: chess pieces are called men

indicators.note: de-tailed, the tail or last letter of the story is cut off

parts.note: a tale is a story

explanation.surface: Brainy chess pieces with a highly detailed narrative.
explanation.walkthrough: 'detailed' looks like 'elaborate' but means losing the tail.
explanation.definitionFit: Mental means relating to the mind or intellect.

clue.text: Will ring road join road north?

indicators.note: join tells the two road pieces to be set side by side

parts.note: O is ring-shaped
the A1 is Britain's main north road, written AI in crosswords
the A1 is Britain's main north road, written AI in crosswords

explanation.surface: A planner wondering whether the ring road will link to the road heading north.
explanation.walkthrough: The A1 is the longest numbered road in Britain, running north from London to Edinburgh; crosswords write the 1 as I.
explanation.definitionFit: To will as a verb is to decree or command, a synonym of ordain.

clue.text: They help pick up each run with dribbles

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for run
drops are small dribbles of liquid

explanation.surface: Football jargon: players helping each other pick up the game by running and dribbling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pick up' means hear, as one picks up a sound.
explanation.definitionFit: Medicated drops put into the ear treat it and aid hearing, so they help one catch sounds.

clue.text: Retiring from game, nice to make movies

indicators.note: Retiring says the hidden letters are read backwards
the clue word that says the letters sit inside the next words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A sportsman quits the game, glad to go into films.
explanation.definitionFit: Cinema is the art and industry of film-making.

clue.text: Isolated ones left sardines at sea

indicators.note: at sea means confused, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Lonely people abandoned the sardines while out on the ocean.
explanation.definitionFit: People living on islands are cut off by the sea, hence isolated.

clue.text: Main Eric Cantona act after performance

indicators.note: once the act has been performed, its letters are worked into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: The footballer's main act comes after a display on the pitch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Main' is the old poetic word for the open sea, not 'chief'.
explanation.definitionFit: The main is a literary term for the high seas, and this is one of the world's great oceans.

clue.text: Roll for bad heel, so king starts

indicators.note: starts says the preceding pieces come at the beginning

parts.note: sic is Latin for thus or so
K is the chess abbreviation for king
a ship that heels leans over, or lists

explanation.surface: A bad-tempered king starts rolling over, like a tyrant falling.
explanation.definitionFit: A roll is a register of names, here those who are ill, bad meaning unwell.

clue.text: Drunk back late gets drink

indicators.note: drunk suggests the letters are reeling into a new order

explanation.surface: A drunkard returns home late and gets another drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Tea served without milk is a common hot beverage.

clue.text: Nick's short match on grass

indicators.note: on puts the first piece above the next in this down clue
short says the last letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: to cope with is to match or be equal to
to grass or shop someone is to inform on them to police

explanation.surface: A footballer's brief match on a grass pitch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nick' is British slang for a police station; 'grass' and 'shop' are both slang for informing.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are British slang names for a police station.

clue.text: Player with loads of space taking time — back to Scholes

indicators.note: taking means the space swallows the time piece

parts.note: acres means a large amount of room

indicators.note: back to picks the last letter of the name

explanation.surface: A footballer with plenty of space takes his time before passing back to Scholes.
explanation.walkthrough: Paul Scholes was Cantona's Manchester United teammate.
explanation.definitionFit: A player is a performer on stage, and this is a female one.

clue.text: Extremely poor setters no longer possessed pens

indicators.note: pens means encloses, so one piece is put inside the other

parts.note: lost means no longer had
we, the setters, speaking of themselves

explanation.surface: Crossword compilers so broke they lost their pens.
explanation.definitionFit: The superlative of low means of the worst or most inferior quality.

clue.text: Justify clash and tirade

parts.note: war is armed conflict, a clash
a rant is an angry tirade

explanation.surface: Someone defending a quarrel and an angry outburst.
explanation.definitionFit: To warrant something is to give grounds for it, to make it justified.

clue.text: Cheer home Eric, essentially, during double

parts.note: in means at home

indicators.note: during places the middle of Eric inside the double

parts.note: a spit, as in spitting image, is a double or lookalike

indicators.note: essentially picks the core letters of Eric

explanation.surface: Fans cheer the return of Eric, essentially seeing double.
explanation.definitionFit: To inspirit is to encourage or hearten someone, to cheer them.

clue.text: Special skill concerning French thinker

parts.note: art means a skill or knack
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: A rare ability relating to a philosopher from France.
explanation.definitionFit: Jean-Paul Sartre was the French existentialist philosopher.

clue.text: Clip of footballer showing no hesitation

indicators.note: showing no says the hesitation is taken out

parts.note: Alan Shearer, the England and Newcastle striker
er is a hesitant sound

explanation.surface: Video of a striker who never hesitates in front of goal.
explanation.definitionFit: To clip is to cut or trim, as one does a sheep's fleece.

clue.text: See 2
Very busy Man United player approaching half-time without oxygen

indicators.note: approaching puts the first piece just before the next

parts.note: Manchester United are the Red Devils, so a player is a red

indicators.note: without here means outside, so oxygen goes inside

parts.note: O is the chemical symbol for oxygen

explanation.surface: A United player running out of breath as the interval nears.
explanation.definitionFit: Red hot describes something intensely active, as a market or a phone line can be.

clue.text: Looks calm here and passes

parts.note: the eye of a storm is the calm spot at its centre
in football, a ball is a pass

explanation.surface: A cool-headed footballer surveys the field and passes.
explanation.definitionFit: To eyeball is to stare or look hard at, so as a verb it means looks.

clue.text: Quickly ace goes to moron …

indicators.note: goes to says the first piece is joined in front of the next

parts.note: A is the card abbreviation for ace
a sap is a fool

explanation.surface: The best card is handed to an idiot in a hurry.
explanation.definitionFit: Initialism for as soon as possible, so with haste.

clue.text: … knackers pitch and charges

parts.note: to cast is to pitch or throw
rates are fees or charges

explanation.surface: Continuing the previous clue: an idiot who wears out the pitch and runs up fees.
explanation.walkthrough: 'knackers' looks like British slang for exhausts, but as a verb it means removes the testicles.
explanation.definitionFit: To knacker can mean to geld an animal, a literal sense alongside the slang tire out.
